scripts.check: npm run check:api && npm run check:web
scripts.check:api: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.check:web: npm run test:e2e -w apps/web && npm run lint -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.render:build:api: npm install && npm exec -w apps/api -- prisma generate && npm run build -w apps/api && npm exec -w apps/api -- prisma migrate deploy
